اعتقدا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَقَدَا (iʕtaqadā) /iʕ.ta.qa.daː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# اُعْتُقِدَا (uʕtuqidā) /uʕ.tu.qi.daː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# اِعْتَقِدَا (iʕtaqidā) /iʕ.ta.qi.daː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
